requirements: R1: Reconcile task status where internal system incorrectly marks task as done when the PR is closed without merge.
R2: Unblock flow core task generation loop caused by tasks stuck due to sync failures.

slices.title: Patch task synchronization logic and clear flow core loop
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub sync patch for this epic, I want to accurately propagate unmerged closed PR states and clear loops, so that the flow core can resume processing active work.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task linked to an unmerged closed PR,
When the sync process runs and unit tests assert the state transition,
Then the task status is reverted and the generation loop is cleared.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive done tasks from >0 to 0
